title: 3:00 - Arrive and prepare for shift
items: Get with opening manager on AM shift notes.
Make floorplan for PM shift.
Do a prep check with the AM manager.

title: 3:15 - Any restaurant errands needed
items: Do a change run to the bank
Do a liquor run in states that require a pickup from the state ABC

title: 3:30 - Game plan your shift
items: Check e-mails, read notes from previous shifts
Look at last year's sales and today's sales projections
Check your ordering calendar to see what orders need to be prepped/placed/received today
Assign cleaning projects to team members as needed.

title: Monitor team members as they arrive
items: Are team members arriving on time?
Uniform checks as team members arrive.

title: 5:45 - Shift meeting with all FOH.
items: Double check uniforms
Review contests, policies, cleaning duties, upsell focus, reviews and secret shopper visits

title: 6:00 - Execute a successful shift.
items: Manage labor - making shift cuts as business dictates.
Follow up on any cleaning projects that were assigned to team members at the beginning of the shift

title: 6:00-7:00 Check Exterior Lights
items: Check the building and parking lot lights.

title: 8:00 - Complete server check outs
items: If team members are turning in signed credit card receipts, compare the credit card tip entered vs what is written

title: 9:30 - Check employees clocked in report. Make sure all employees are clocked out
items: Clock out any team members who need to be clocked out.
Adjust in times and out times, if needed.

title: Hot Counts for the Shift
items: Hot Counts for the Shift

title: AFTER THE LAST GUEST LEAVES
items: Turn off TV’s and radio
Servers start to flip chairs
Get restaurant CLEAN, SET, READY for the next shift in FOH and HOH
Make sure all shift reviews have been completed.
After all shift reviews have been completed, print report. Distribute tip out.
Change out small bills from Petty Cash for big ones out of bar/to go drawers. Balance Petty Cash, Bar and To Go drawers
Follow up with cooks on cleaning. Trash runs, cooler organized, pans flipped, under equipment

title: Close out cash for end of day.
items: Count money in office drawer and compare to Expected Deposit.
On the Toast back-office Sales Summary, Expected Deposit and Total Cash MUST match. If it doesn’t, something is wrong or incomplete.
Fill out deposit slip and place in deposit bag with the money.

title: Ready for End of Night Report?
items: Make sure all employees have clocked out (Close Out Day on Handheld) and that hours/job codes are accurate. (Toast Back Office Labor Summary)

title: Run Close Out Day on handheld device.
items: Batch credit cards.
Close out drawers.
Add deposit.

title: Fill out Nightly Email sheet/ Logbook entry.
items: Add information to your nightly email/logbook entry.

title: Lock Up & Go Home
items: Make sure all doors are locked.
Turn up AC’s, if needed.
Turn off all lights.
Set alarm. Leave.
Deposit money into the bank night drop.
